# Simulation Studies

This chapter introduces the simulation utilities in `r pkg("seqpatch")`.
The `sim_gene_counts()` function generates count data for group comparisons,
whereas `sim_gene_ts_counts()` generates count data with defined temporal expression patterns.
For group comparison simulations, `def_DEG()` identifies the true DEG status
from the simulated fold changes and a user-defined cutoff.
Together, these functions support controlled evaluations of normalization and
differentially expressed gene (DEG) workflows,
including settings with compositional imbalance or asymmetric DEG patterns.
